description: Render a traditional Chinese name seal (印章) as a PNG image for a Western/English name. The name is transliterated into seal script (篆書) characters chosen for meaning, and the result includes each character meaning. Returns a base64 PNG plus an explanation. Free, no API key.

ink.description: Carving mode: positive 朱文 (red characters on paper), negative 白文 (characters cut out of a solid red field). Default positive.

shape.description: Seal shape: square 方章, circle 圆印, oval 椭圆名章 (default square)

size.description: PNG edge length in px (64-1024, default 512)

name: render_chinese_name_seal
